scanner-integration job still runs unchanged: line 251 "needs: [clear-vote, require-ticket, classify]" and line 252 if-guard runs on full route; commit message states "The job still RUNS on the full route (advisory)"
blocking.finding: Removing scanner-integration from vote.needs and the route-completeness gates does NOT make it non-gating, because CONCLUSION is ultimately taken from env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION (line 512), which im-open/workflow-conclusion populates from a REST snapshot of ALL of this run's jobs (per the comment at lines 447-449), not from vote.needs. scanner-integration still runs (needs/if unchanged at lines 251-252), so a scanner failure sets WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION=failure -> normalize -> 'failure' -> Verified-1, defeating the stated intent and not resolving incident 90c7.
scenarios: A full-route change whose scanner-integration contracts fail while build-and-test/mutation/optionality/etc all pass: WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION snapshot includes the failed scanner job -> CONCLUSION='failure' -> Verified-1, i.e. the exact fleet-wide lock this change claims to remove.
